hooks.command: rpi_root="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$rpi_root/.codex/hooks/guard-bash.sh" ] && [ "$rpi_root" != / ]; do rpi_root=${rpi_root%/*}; rpi_root=${rpi_root:-/}; done; if [ ! -f "$rpi_root/.codex/hooks/guard-bash.sh" ]; then printf "%s\n" "BLOCKED / WHY: installed policy wrapper unavailable from native hook cwd. / FIX: launch the client inside the trusted project and run the read-only installation check." >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$rpi_root/.codex/hooks/guard-bash.sh" codex
